follow-up time: 3 months of treatment, with scar assessment at 9 months post-treatment
outcome: Appearance of post-cesarean section surgical wounds
Symptoms of post-cesarean section surgical wounds
Patient and Observer Scar Assessment Scale (POSAS) scores
cohort: 26 women with post-cesarean section scars (20 completed the trial)
finding: Topical tranilast 8% gel significantly improved the cosmetic appearance of post-cesarean section scars compared to placebo, as measured by POSAS scores and patient satisfaction.
mod_finding: Topical tranilast 8% gel significantly improved the cosmetic appearance of post-cesarean section scars compared to placebo, as measured by POSAS scores and patient satisfaction.
